subject: PrivDeploy: usage floor, platform fee amortization & SLA exceptions
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex@lumena-health.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Viktor Lund <viktor.lund@lumena-health.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment pricing and SLA questions

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lumena is keen to move to a private VPC deployment for PHI workloads, but procurement needs clarity on three things before we loop legal:

1) Platform fee amortization: can Redwood amortize the platform fee over 12 months on invoices instead of a lump up-front charge?
2) Usage floor and overage math: we expect bursty inference for triage hours; what does the minimum commit look like and how are overages invoiced?
3) SLA exceptions & response tiers: we need explicit escalation commitments for Severity 1 incidents during our core business hours (M-F 7am–7pm PST).

Can you share a short commercial proposal (numbers + payment cadence) so procurement can review?

Best,
Alex
VP Product, Lumena Health

--
Lumena Health | alex@lumena-health.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex@lumena-health.com>
Cc: Viktor Lund <viktor.lund@lumena-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and SLA questions

Alex —

Thanks for laying out the asks. Attaching a short commercial note that maps to your questions (see proposal_lumena_privdeploy_v1.pdf). High-level options below so procurement can pick a path:

Option A (Starter Pilot, 6 months)
- Platform fee: $60k total, invoiceable over 6 months (monthly amortization available)
- Minimum commit: 250k tokens/month floor (applies months 2–6), overage billed monthly at $0.0009/token
- Support: Standard Private (business hours M-F 9am–5pm PT), 24x7 optional add-on

Option B (Production Onramp, 12 months) — recommended
- Platform fee: $100k, amortizable over 12 months (we can include amortization schedule in the contract)
- Minimum commit: 150k tokens/month floor (12-month term); burst cushion included (up to 40% monthly)
- Support: Premium Private (M-F 7am–7pm PT, 1-hour P1 response during business hours, on-call rotation)
- Conditional 10% volume discount in year 1 for a signed 12-month commitment

Commercial notes / exceptions
- SLA exceptions: we can commit to the P1 response and a defined escalation path; availability SLA and credits are tied to monitored uptime and agreed maintenance windows.
- Special ask re: amortization timing: we can amortize the platform fee on invoices (monthly) if procurement confirms a 12-month payment cadence in the SOW.

Attachments: proposal_lumena_privdeploy_v1.pdf (commercial summary), SOW_draft_lumena.docx (operational terms, milestones)

Next steps I suggest: procurement picks Option A or B and flags any legal redlines — we’ll route to commercial for discount approval and to ops for the pilot timeline. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with procurement this week.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

--
Note: internal team included (Marissa, Ben) to confirm pricing levers and whether we can grant the 10% concession on DL-4832.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and SLA questions (internal approval)

Priya —

Quick internal read and recommended adjustments before we share a formal SOW to Lumena:

- Option A: ok as pilot; platform fee $60k is fine, but make sure margin holds if we allow monthly amortization (cashflow hit). Recommend net effective discount no greater than 5% for pilots.
- Option B: 12-month amortization is acceptable. Approve the conditional 10% volume discount on the following conditions: (a) 12-month non-cancellable commit, (b) minimum annualized token volume >= 1.8M, (c) up to two quarterly true-ups.
- SLA & P1: we can offer 1-hour response during Lumena business hours. Escalation to L2 SRE takes up to 2 hours unless hotfix required. Do not promise 24x7 P1 without an add-on retainer.

Also: recommend adding a one-time onboarding credit of $10k (SOW credit) if they sign the 12-month option in 10 business days. That reduces up-front friction and preserves pricing integrity.

Ben — can you confirm SOW language around amortization schedule and proposed invoice mapping? If legal pushes for platform fee as lump-sum we should offer a finance-approved compromise: 30% upfront, remainder amortized monthly.

-Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex@lumena-health.com>
Cc: Viktor Lund <viktor.lund@lumena-health.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and SLA questions

Alex / Viktor —

Appreciate the quick review. Couple of updates after an internal pricing check:

- We can offer Option B (recommended) with the 10% year-1 volume discount if Lumena confirms a 12-month minimum and annualized token volume >= 1.8M. I’ve put the conditional language in the attached SOW draft.
- Platform fee amortization: Redwood can amortize the platform fee on monthly invoices for a 12-month cadence. If legal requires any portion upfront, we propose 30% upfront + remaining 70% amortized monthly.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $10k credit applied to month 1 if contract signed within 10 business days after countersignature.
- SLA: we will commit to 1-hour P1 response during M-F 7am–7pm PT and a documented escalation ladder. 24x7 P1 can be added as a retainer.

Next steps: I’ve attached the updated proposal and SOW. If this looks acceptable, I can (a) share the DocuSign link to the commercial term sheet and (b) loop legal for a quick review of the SOW redlines. Which do you prefer? Happy to hop on a 20-min call today.

Thanks,
Priya

Attachments: proposal_lumena_privdeploy_v1.pdf, SOW_draft_lumena.docx

To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Viktor Lund <viktor.lund@lumena-health.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and SLA questions

Thanks Priya — this is helpful. Lumena is comfortable moving forward with Option B subject to a single commercial tweak: we need the platform fee amortization on the invoice schedule (monthly) and prefer no more than 20% upfront if any. Your 30% upfront proposal is a little high for our finance team — can you do 20% upfront / 80% amortized?

Also please route the SOW to our legal (legal@lumena-health.com) once you’ve accepted the 20/80 split so we can start redlining. If we can get that in DocuSign this week we’ll aim to countersign quickly and trigger the onboarding credit.

Appreciate the flexibility — moving to legal now.

Best,
Alex
VP Product, Lumena Health
